HD-BCP-DR-Test-Record-2026.pdf.text:
Continuity plan and restore test record
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Plan
The current continuity plan v3 took effect on 2026-06-01. It requires the patient telemetry tier to recover within 60 minutes and lose at most 15 minutes of committed data.
The resilience dashboard labels the January 2026 exercise as proof of v3 operating effectiveness.
Exercise
The 2026-01-15 exercise restored a staging database under plan v2. Its 48-minute result is retained as history. A production-tier v3 exercise is scheduled for 2026-11-05.
Backup sample
An unrelated monthly encrypted snapshot restore on 2026-09-18 completed in 39 minutes, with checksum match and signed QA validation. This sample tested backup integrity, not the full failover runbook.

HD-Configuration-and-Risk-Review-Q3.pdf.text:
Configuration and risk review
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Configuration
Baseline policy requires all managed endpoints to apply the approved hardening profile. September compliance dashboard shows 221 of 260 production endpoints passing; the steering report labels the baseline fully deployed.
Software maintenance tickets follow monthly change control; the August release review records 23 of 23 approved production changes.
Risk response
The risk council met on 2026-09-25. Its decision log says remediation actions are complete for all critical scan findings, while the Security Hub dashboard retains two open critical findings.
The response selection for vulnerable telemetry export components is to patch, rather than accept or avoid.

HD-Cybersecurity-Policy-v4.pdf.text:
Cybersecurity policy v4
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Operating rules
The policy applies to US production accounts and the Pune engineering center. Critical vulnerabilities must be remediated within 15 calendar days of discovery. The exception board may approve a dated compensating control before the deadline.
Administrative service identities may use only federated short-lived credentials; static access keys and standing AdministratorAccess are forbidden. Quarterly IAM review is signed by a second approver.
Monitoring
EDR must report healthy for every managed endpoint, including contractor devices. The SOC ingests AWS Security Hub findings and records triage each shift.
Continuity
The recovery tier for patient telemetry has a 60-minute RTO and 15-minute RPO. Monthly restore tests and annual tabletop exercises are required.

HD-Identity-Monitoring-and-Recovery-Summ.text:
Identity, monitoring and recovery summary
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Identity
Workforce SSO uses phishing-resistant MFA. Quarterly identity proofing samples were signed on 2026-09-20. The private management VLAN 10.44.8.0/24 reaches the bastion only after VPN and device posture checks.
Monitoring
Network flow logs and cloud audit logs are retained for 365 days and reviewed by the 24x7 SOC. The 2026-09-20 parser verification succeeded for all connected production accounts.
Recovery
Production patient telemetry volumes use AES-256 at rest under account-scoped KMS keys; encrypted backups run daily. The 2026-09-18 checksum-verified restore passed with 39-minute completion; a separate full continuity exercise is scheduled.
Historical exception
A disconnected test container from 2025 carried a high scanner result. It was destroyed on 2026-01-12; closure evidence and the image digest are in the risk archive.

HD-Incident-Response-Plan-v3.pdf.text:
Incident response plan v3
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Detection and escalation
The SOC triages high-confidence alerts within 20 minutes and opens a commander bridge for severity one events. The commander, forensic lead, clinical operations liaison and communications lead have named duties. Patient-safety and customer operations leads are paged after severity confirmation.
The incident commander records scope, containment, evidence hashes and hand-off to recovery. Tabletop observations feed the next monthly control review.
Communication
The internal call tree is tested quarterly. External messages use approved customer communication templates. The Pune clinical-operations paging group is not included in the current internal notification connector.

HD-Tabletop-After-Action-2026.pdf.text:
Ransomware tabletop after-action report
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Exercise
On 2026-08-21, 17 responders ran a simulated telemetry-queue compromise. SOC declared severity one in 12 minutes, isolated the workload in 19 minutes and identified the affected tenant in 27 minutes.
Observers verified bridge attendance, escalation to clinical operations, preserved event logs and a customer-communications draft. Four improvements were assigned; three closed by 2026-09-28 and the remaining item is a noncritical contact-list update due 2026-10-15.
Approval
The VP Security and clinical operations director signed the report on 2026-08-28. The 2026-09-23 check confirmed action evidence in the ticket archive.
